title: Built a full turn-based crime game in Unity with AI art, music, and code — giving promo codes to the first 20 beta testers
author: Sad_Whereas_6161
selftext:
I’m René, a solo dev. **Lushgrave** is a dark turn-based crime and trading game for Android, now in closed beta on Google Play.

**How I used AI:**

* 🎨 **Art** — all AI-generated
* 🎵 **Music** — all AI-generated
* 💻 **Code** — a lot of it written with AI (Unity / C#), then debugged and wired together by me

The game design, systems, balancing, and putting it all together are mine.

🎁 **The first 20 beta testers get a free promo code!**

**Play Store:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chronalynx.lushgrave](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chronalynx.lushgrave)  
(Join links are in the first comment 👇)

Happy to answer questions about the workflow 🙏

comments.author: Sad_Whereas_6161
comments.body:
**How to join:**

1. Join the tester group: [https://groups.google.com/g/lushgrave-testers](https://groups.google.com/g/lushgrave-testers)
2. Opt in: [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.chronalynx.lushgrave](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.chronalynx.lushgrave)
3. Install from the Play Store link above and keep it installed for 14 days 🙏

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: Not trying to be an asshole, but I don't get where people get the balls to drop low quality slop and act like people would be lining up to get a free promo code to their slop. Like why would anyone want to waste their time to try your game that looks incredibly low effort.
